eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Nine
subtitle: Lesson 80 · Window and Ranking Functions

eyebrow: A unique, sequential number per row
code:
SELECT Name, ListPrice,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ListPrice DESC)
    AS PriceRank
FROM Production.Product;
caption: 1, 2, 3... ROW_NUMBER() REQUIRES an ORDER BY — unlike Lesson 79's AVG/COUNT.

code:
SELECT Name, Color, ListPrice,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY Color ORDER BY ListPrice DESC)
    AS RankInColor
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Numbering RESTARTS at 1 for each color — the most expensive WITHIN each group.

code:
SELECT *,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY FirstName, LastName, EmailPromotion
    ORDER BY BusinessEntityID) AS RowNum
FROM Person.Person;
-- RowNum > 1 = a duplicate
caption: The exact same technique from the deduplication lesson.
